integrity: The proof derives the exact facet offsets directly from the Minkowski sum, uses the published exhaustive facet indexing, obtains a sharp all-center upper bound from singleton facets, and verifies every other facet by a monotonicity inequality for (2^(j-1)-1)/(j(j-1)). Equality analysis proves both uniqueness and the complete tangency classification. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the standard Minkowski-sum realization of the stellohedron and the intrinsic Euclidean metric of its affine hull. It does not claim metric invariance under general affine equivalence and does not compute circumradii or John ellipsoids. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent folklore consequence of general nestohedron inequalities.
title: Exact Euclidean inradius and unique uniform incenter of the standard stellohedron
